rationale: Sources/SwiftJXLCore/VarDCT/VarDCTSmallAnalysis.swift extracted its 90-line withUnsafeMutableBufferPointer closure body into private helper apply(_:identifier:buffer:dct:) for Linux Swift 6.2 type-checking, changing SwiftJXLCore.o in release-8 while leaving SwiftJXL.o byte-identical. All 11 VarDCT benchmark cases (22 rows: 14 paired with predecessor, 8 candidate-only decode) were re-executed under both --candidate-workers default and --candidate-workers 1 with unchanged tolerances, admission budgets, and defaults.

combinedWithUnchangedModularAndNative.perf03Disposition: Under PERF-03, the 10 constrained one-worker (maximumWorkers=1) latency triggers reflect the deliberate safety/correctness/determinism design (enforcing explicit single-worker admission, bounded <=4096 multiply-add cancellation checkpoints, and cross-platform deterministic Double-accumulated scalar DCT sum order against a predecessor that still invokes DispatchQueue.concurrentPerform and Apple Accelerate vDSP_mmul/vDSP_mtrans Float matrices). Per PERF-03, the coding agent does not waive these 10 rows; they remain open diagnostic findings requiring explicit owner acceptance of the constrained-worker baseline or further single-worker kernel optimisation before a stable release.
